sentences.en: + A9 TopSage.com Tonight I'm going to talk to you about that remarkable continent Antarctica - remote, hostile and at present uninhabited on a permanent basis.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: A9 TopSage.com 今晚，我将向大家介绍那片非凡的大陆——南极洲：遥远、严酷，目前尚无永久居民。

sentences.en: For early explorers, it was the ultimate survival contest; for researchers like me, it remains a place of great intellectual challenge; while for the modern tourist, it's simply a wilderness of great beauty.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 对早期探险家而言，它曾是终极的生存挑战；对我这样的研究人员来说，它至今仍是一处充满巨大智力挑战之地；而对现代游客而言，它则纯粹是一片壮美绝伦的荒野。

sentences.en: First, some facts and figures.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 首先，让我们了解一些基本事实和数据。

sentences.en: Antarctica is a place of extremes - the highest, coldest and windiest continent and over fifty-eight times the size of the UK.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 南极洲是一个极端之地——它是全球海拔最高、气温最低、风力最强的大陆，面积超过英国的58倍。

sentences.en: The ice-cap contains almost 70% of the world's fresh water and 90% of its ice, but with very low snowfall, most of the continent technically falls unbelievably into the category of 'desert'!
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 南极冰盖储存了全球近70%的淡水和90%的冰；但由于降雪量极低，从技术上讲，南极大陆大部分地区竟不可思议地被归类为‘沙漠’！

sentences.en: Huge icebergs break off the continent each year, while in winter half the surrounding ocean freezes over, which means its size almost doubles.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 每年都有巨大的冰山从大陆崩解脱落；而到了冬季，其周边海洋约一半面积会结冰，这意味着南极洲的实际面积几乎翻倍。

sentences.en: Research and exploration has been going on in Antarctica for more than two hundred years, and has involved scientists from many different countries, who work together on research stations.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 南极洲的科研与探索活动已持续两百多年，来自众多国家的科学家共同参与，在各研究站协同工作。

sentences.en: Here science and technical support have been integrated in a very cost-effective way our Antarctic research programme has several summers-only stations and two all-year-round ones; I was based on one of the all-year-round ones.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 在这里，科研与技术支持以极具成本效益的方式紧密结合：我们的南极研究计划设有若干个仅在夏季运行的考察站，以及两座全年运行的考察站；我本人就驻扎在其中一座全年运行的考察站。

sentences.en: The research stations are really self-contained communities of about twenty people.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 这些考察站实际上是自给自足的小型社区，每站约有二十人。

sentences.en: There's living and working space, kitchen with a huge food store, a small hospital and a well-equipped gym to ensure everyone keeps fit in their spare time.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 站内设有生活与工作空间、配备大量食品储备的厨房、小型医院，以及设施齐全的健身房，以确保所有人在闲暇时间保持身体健康。

sentences.en: The station generates its own electricity and communicates with the outside world using satellite link.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 考察站自行发电，并通过卫星链路与外界保持通信。

sentences.en: Our station - Zero One - had some special features.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 我们所在的‘零一号’考察站具有一些特殊设计。

sentences.en: It wasn't built on land but on an ice-shelf, hundreds of metres thick.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 它并非建于陆地上，而是建在数百米厚的冰架之上。

sentences.en: Supplies were brought to us on large sledges from a ship fifteen kilometres away at the ice edge.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 补给物资由大型雪橇从十五公里外、位于冰缘处的船舶运抵我们站点。

sentences.en: Living in the Antarctic hasn't always been so comfortable.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 在南极生活并不总是如此舒适。

sentences.en: Snow build-ups caused enormous problems for four previous stations on the same site, which were buried and finally crushed by the weight.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 积雪堆积曾给同一地点先前建成的四座考察站带来巨大难题——这些站房最终被积雪掩埋并因积雪重压而坍塌。

sentences.en: Fortunately no-one was hurt, but these buildings became a huge challenge to architects who finally came up with a remarkable solution - the buildings are placed on platforms which can be raised above the changing snow level on legs which are extendable.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 幸运的是无人受伤，但这些倒塌的建筑却给建筑师们带来了巨大挑战；他们最终提出了一项卓越的解决方案——将建筑物置于可升降平台上，平台由可伸缩支柱支撑，从而能随积雪高度变化而抬升。

sentences.en: Food is one of the most important aspects of survival in a polar climate.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 食物是极地气候下维系生存的最重要因素之一。

sentences.en: People living there need to obtain a lot more energy from their food, both to keep warm and to undertake heavy physical work.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 居住在那里的人需要从食物中摄取远超平常的能量，既用于御寒，也用于从事繁重的体力劳动。

sentences.en: Maybe you know that an adult in the UK will probably need about 1,700 kilocalories day on average; someone in Antarctica will need about 3,500 - just over double!
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 或许你们知道，一名英国成年人平均每天约需1700千卡热量；而在南极，每人每日所需热量约为3500千卡——足足超过两倍！

sentences.en: This energy is provided by foods which are high in carbohydrate and fat.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 这些能量主要由富含碳水化合物和脂肪的食物提供。

sentences.en: Rations for fieldwork present an additional problem.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 野外作业的口粮则带来另一重挑战。

sentences.en: They need to provide maximum energy, but they must also be compact and light for easy transport.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 它们必须提供最大化的能量，同时又须紧凑轻便，便于运输。

sentences.en: Special boxes are prepared, each containing enough food for one person for twenty days.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 我们专门准备了特制箱装口粮，每箱可供一人使用二十天。

sentences.en: You may be familiar with coffee www.TopSage.com 7.3108 processed by freeze-drying, which preserves the quality of the food product while making a, large saving in weight - well, this type of presentation is idcal in our situation.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 你们或许熟悉经冷冻干燥工艺处理的咖啡（www.TopSage.com 7.3108），该工艺可在大幅减轻重量的同时完好保存食品品质；这种包装形式正契合我们的实际需求。

sentences.en: It wasn't Sage.com available to earlier polar explorers, whose diet was commonly insufficient for their health.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 此类食品在早期极地探险家时代尚不可得，当时他们的饮食普遍无法满足健康所需。

sentences.en: think that being at the cutting edge of science has special appeal for everyone working in Antarctica, in whatever capacity.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 我认为，站在科学前沿这一特质，对所有在南极洲工作的人员——无论其岗位如何——都具有独特吸引力。

sentences.en: As a marine biologist, my own rescarch was fascinating; but it's perhaps climate change research that is the most crucial field of study.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 作为一名海洋生物学家，我自己的研究令人着迷；但或许，气候变化研究才是当前最为关键的研究领域。

sentences.en: Within this general field, surveying changes in the volume and stability of the ice-cap is vital, since these may have profound effects on world sea levels and on ocean currents.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 在这一总体范畴内，监测冰盖体积与稳定性的变化至关重要，因为这些变化可能对全球海平面及洋流产生深远影响。

sentences.en: A second important area is monitoring the size of the hole in the ozone layer above Antarctica, since this is an indicator of global ultra-violet radiation levels.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 第二个重要领域是持续监测南极上空臭氧层空洞的大小，因为这正是全球紫外线辐射水平的重要指标。

sentences.en: Thirdly, bubbles in the ice-sheet itself provide an index of pollution because frozen inside them are samples of previous atmospheres over the past 500,000 years, and these provide us with evidence for the effects of such human activities as agriculture and industry.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 第三，冰盖内部封存的气泡本身即是一种污染指数——这些气泡冻结了过去五十万年间不同历史时期的空气样本，为我们提供了农业与工业等人类活动所造成影响的直接证据。

sentences.en: There are an increasing number of opportunities for young people to work for a period in Antarctica - not only as research assistants in projects like mine, but also in a wide range of junior administrative and technical positions including vacancies for map-makers.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 如今，年轻人赴南极工作一段时间的机会日益增多——不仅包括像我所从事项目中的科研助理岗位，还涵盖各类初级行政与技术职位，例如制图员等空缺岗位。

sentences.en: I hope that the insights I've provided will encourage you to take up these opportunities in this fascinating continent.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 我希望，我所提供的这些见解能激励你们把握住在这片迷人大陆上的种种机遇。
